text.tspan: Source: UC-50 NF1–9, A3a, A4a; BR115, BR144–145

Proposed function-level design derived from the SRS. Class, method, DTO and parameter names may change during implementation. Business behavior, data and branch conditions follow the cited UC / BR / NS requirements. UI messages are translated; SRS message IDs are retained.

Preconditions: authenticated Moderator; ticket status is Pending / In Progress. UC-50 does not specify an email failure path; UC-64's email failure handling is not applied here. expectedVersion is the proposed optimistic-lock token from the viewed ticket; exact field naming may change.
